user.title: Set up your Wall Panel
user.description: Double press: next entity. Hold: entity selection menu. In the menu, rotate to highlight, press to select, hold to cancel. Buttons, relays, audio and displays belong to this integration; MQTT is the local transport.

data_description.entities: Choose any number of Climate, Weather, Light, Cover and Media Player entities. Media pages rotate volume; press plays/pauses where supported, otherwise toggles mute where available.
data_description.include_clock: Adds a read-only time/date page using Home Assistant's time zone. Clock appears after the chosen entities.
data_description.temperature_step: Set 0 to use the thermostat's own temperature step.

button.title: Button {button} assignments
button.description: Assign single and double press independently. For scenes or other HA actions, select Run Home Assistant actions and use the action editor below. Local relay assignments are saved on the panel and work without HA/Wi-Fi; configuring one does not switch the relay. All four buttons work on the first press with the main display off and do not wake it. Single press waits 400 ms to distinguish double press. These buttons do not provide a reliable long-press signal.
